note: Nineteenth-century Protestant reference works (KJV numbering, Protestant canon and theology). The UI must label them as such. Scripture references are stored in the app anchor (Clementine Vulgate) numbering.
terms: terms.json maps lowercase term/alias to an entry index, or to an array of indexes when several entries share the name

easton.source: Easton's Bible Dictionary, M. G. Easton (Illustrated Bible Dictionary, 3rd ed., Thomas Nelson, 1897). Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
easton.edition: 1897 (third edition, published three years after the author's death); CCEL text from the Online Bible, illustrations omitted
easton.license: Public domain (CCEL records Rights: Public Domain; first published 1897). Nineteenth-century Protestant work, KJV numbering.

smith.source: Smith's Bible Dictionary, William Smith (American edition, revised by H. B. Hackett with E. Abbott). Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
smith.edition: 1884 (as given on the CCEL title page)
smith.license: Public domain (CCEL records Rights: Public Domain; published 1884). Nineteenth-century Protestant work, KJV numbering.

nave.source: Nave's Topical Bible, Orville J. Nave. Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
nave.edition: Orville J. Nave, 1896 (CCEL: "created ... in 1896"; the first printed edition is commonly dated 1896/1897)
nave.license: Public domain by age (Nave died 1917; first published 1896/97). CCEL leaves its Rights field blank for this work, so the basis is publication date and author death, not a CCEL statement.
